mia (Design): Noticed a couple of a11y nits in the top toolbar: the focus halo is nearly invisible in light theme and keyboarding opens the kebab menu but Tab skips the menu items. Also saw VoiceOver read the button label twice on open. Can we triage?
omar (Frontend): Thanks — likely two separate problems: (1) CSS focus is 1px and matches toolbar background, (2) the menu unmounts during close animation which breaks tab flow and may cause duplicate SR announcements if we also update an `aria-live` region.
mia (Design): Screenshot attached. Goal: distinct focus from selection and predictable tab order.
lee (A11y): Quick checklist: - Use outline >=3px or visible box-shadow for focus; avoid color-only cues. - Keep menu mounted during animations; toggle `aria-hidden` after transitionend or manage a focus trap. - Ensure `aria-expanded` on trigger and avoid redundant live regions that announce the same label twice. - Add `prefers-reduced-motion` and `prefers-contrast` tweaks.
dev (QA): Repro on Mac+Safari VoiceOver and Win+Chrome NVDA. Steps: Tab to toolbar -> activate menu -> Tab -> focus skips to main content. I recorded a short clip. I'll add an e2e that tabs into toolbar, opens menu, and asserts focus remains in menu.
omar (Frontend): Quick CSS stopgap:
```
.toolbar button:focus { outline: 3px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.12); outline-offset: 2px; }
```
JS fix: keep menu DOM mounted with `data-closing` until `transitionend` and call `focus()` on the first menuitem on open. Will prototype and post screenshots.
mia (Design): Neutral outline OK for now. We'll review brand accent for active state later.
lee (A11y): Also add test assertions for SR output to avoid duplicates; check live regions and aria attributes.
dev (QA): Marking P2. Will run SR smoke once PR is on staging.
bot-deploy: staging deploy queued for PR 1765
omar (Frontend): Opening PR 1765 with CSS + DOM/focus fixes, tagging @mia + @lee for review. Will update thread with screenshots.
